source_note: 由一个级数收敛证明另一个有关级数的收敛问题
english_source_note: Deducing One Series Convergence from Another
callout_id: 由一个级数收敛证明另一个有关级数的收敛问题#4
statement_en: Let $x_n\in (0,1)$ and $q>0$. If $\sum_{n\geq 1} n^q x_n<+\infty$, then $$\sum_{n\geq 1} x_n(\log(1/x_n))^q<\infty.$$
key_techniques: compare logarithmic powers with polynomial weights
split the index set by decay rate of $x_n$
